**Ticket Title:** `Dynamo MCP QA - Validate search_aloha_funds keyword search and tenant scope`

**Jira:** [KS-982](https://gendvn.atlassian.net/browse/KS-982) | **Epic:** Dynamo MCP — Functional E2E Validation

**User Story:**

> As an **Internal QA Tester**, I want **keyword search results** so that **only authorized funds are returned and there is no cross-tenant leakage**.

**Overview:**

section 5.6 targets `search_aloha_funds`: relevance plus **tenant isolation**. Any cross-tenant result is a **critical** finding per section 9; stop broader testing until triaged.

**Detailed Requirements:**

* **Prompt (example):** _Search for funds matching the keyword `<SEARCH_TERM>`._
* **Expected:** Results are relevant to the keyword; every returned fund ID is also retrievable or consistent with **`get_funds`** for the same session (behavioral scope check — **no** Dynamo UI).
* **Cross-check (black box):** Compare search result fund IDs to `get_funds` list for the same identity; IDs not in `get_funds` warrant investigation.
* **Stop condition:** Suspected **cross-tenant** leakage → file critical security bug immediately (section 9); halt other tests.

**Acceptance Criteria (BDD):**

_Scenario 1 — Happy path_

* **Given** a `<SEARCH_TERM>` that returns at least one fund via `search_aloha_funds`
* **When** results are compared to `get_funds` for the same session
* **Then** returned fund IDs are **within** the accessible set implied by `get_funds` (or explained if design differs)

_Scenario 2 — Error path_

* **Given** a search term that matches nothing
* **When** search runs
* **Then** the response is an empty result set (or explicit "no matches"), not unrelated funds

_Scenario 3 — Edge case (critical)_

* **Given** suspicion of **cross-tenant** exposure
* **When** the tester compares `search_aloha_funds` results to `get_funds` and other MCP reads
* **Then** if any unauthorized fund appears, testing **stops**, a **critical** ticket is filed per section 9, and evidence is preserved with redaction rules

**Definition of Done:** _(verbatim block above)_

## Updated requirements — guide v1.4 (8-tool MCP inventory)

**Effective:** May 2026 (customer confirmation)  
**Sources:** `Dynamo Server/Test Guide/dynamo-mcp-testing-guide_v1.4.md`; `Dynamo Server/Test Guide/dynamo_mcp_testing_stories_v1.2.md`  
**Scope note:** This section **supplements** the description above. **Guide v1.4 section 5.6** marks **`search_aloha_funds` out of scope**; legacy BDD above remains for traceability only.

### User Story (v1.4)

> As an **Internal QA Tester**, I want **this ticket’s matrix and evidence rows to reflect v1.4 inventory** so that **section 5.6 is consistently marked S (skipped)** unless the vendor restores search tooling and revises the guide.

### Overview (v1.4)

**Guide section 5.6 — Search test:** **`search_aloha_funds` is not in the customer-confirmed 8-tool inventory.** Default execution: **no MCP calls** to this tool; matrix row **5.6 Search** — **all cells S** per guide section 6 (pre-filled in v1.4 guide table).

**If vendor restores search:** Re-open guide revision, re-register tools per **[KS-991](https://gendvn.atlassian.net/browse/KS-991)**, then reactivate the **legacy** BDD in the original description under a new guide version—**outside** this v1.4 appendix until published.

**Related context:** Cross-index / tenant-scope questions when search returns are handled historically in **[KS-992](https://gendvn.atlassian.net/browse/KS-992)** (first-time ES vs MSSQL work)—**not** required reading for v1.4 **S** posture.

### Detailed requirements (v1.4)

#### A. Preconditions

* Confirm **`search_aloha_funds`** is **absent** from the client registry (**[KS-991](https://gendvn.atlassian.net/browse/KS-991)**).

#### B. Evidence to record

* Screenshot or log line showing **tool not registered** / not invokable in the MCP client used.
* Matrix attachment in **[KS-993](https://gendvn.atlassian.net/browse/KS-993)** with **S** rationale: *v1.4 out of scope — tool not in 8-tool inventory*.

#### C. Stop / escalation (only if tool reappears unexpectedly)

* If **`search_aloha_funds`** appears without a published guide change, treat as **inventory drift** per guide section 9—halt broad regression, notify vendor, refresh **[KS-991](https://gendvn.atlassian.net/browse/KS-991)**.

### UI/UX & front-end considerations (v1.4)

* Jira comment or sub-note linking the **guide v1.4** PDF/MD revision that removed 5.6 execution.

### Acceptance criteria (BDD, v1.4)

_Scenario 1 — Happy path (v1.4 default)_

* **Given** v1.4 inventory without **`search_aloha_funds`**
* **When** the tester closes matrix row **5.6**
* **Then** all applicable cells are **S** with rationale and no unauthorized tool calls are attempted as “pass”

_Scenario 2 — Error path_

* **Given** a tester mistakenly attempts the legacy prompt while the tool is absent
* **When** executed
* **Then** the client shows a clear **missing tool / not found** class error—documented, not scored as functional pass

_Scenario 3 — Edge case_

* **Given** vendor restores search and updates the guide
* **When** product management publishes a new inventory
* **Then** this ticket is **re-baselined** under the new guide version (outside this appendix)

### Definition of Done (v1.4)

Unchanged from the **Definition of Done** block in the original description above; for QA execution, add: **5.6** matrix **S** evidence attached or linked in **[KS-993](https://gendvn.atlassian.net/browse/KS-993)**.
